entities.name: Rishkar
entities.description: An Elf Druid and cultivator from Peema on Avishkar, fierce advocate of the Renegades' cause.

entities.name: Peema
entities.description: Forest region where Rishkar came from.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: City where the Inventors' Fair is held and Rishkar now lives.

entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: Cause championed by Rishkar, fighting for free access to aether.

events.summary: Rishkar came to Ghirapur for the Inventors' Fair, witnessed the Consulate's crackdown and aether shortages, and resolved to fight for free aether.
events.quote: he would fight for free access to aether for all

relations.note: A fierce advocate of their cause.
relations.quote: He has become a fierce advocate of the Renegades ' cause
